title: Lease Term Agreement Terms — Transfer to Another Apartment Home in the Same Community
content:
A resident may move to another available apartment home in the same community by a transfer, which the resident signs. The current Lease Term Agreement then ends as transferred and a new transfer term begins.

## Clause 1 — Months into the term

A transfer may be signed only when the current date is on or after the term start date plus the program's months-into-term figure for transfers. Months into the term are counted in calendar months from the term start date to the same day number of a later month, falling back to the last day of that month when that day number does not exist.

| Hypothetical term start, 6 months required | Signing date | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 February | 31 July | Too early |
| 1 February | 1 August | May be signed |
| 30 September | 30 March of the next year | May be signed (the first such day) |

## Clause 2 — Further conditions

A transfer further requires all of the following:

1. the program allows transfers;
2. a transfer move date at least the program's transfer notice days (calendar days) after the date the request was submitted;
3. a trailing transfer count below the program's transfers allowed per trailing 365 days;
4. no past-due balance on the lease, when the program requires it;
5. a destination floor plan that admits the household under the Apartment Home Lease rules.

## Clause 3 — Effect of signing

3.1 The current term ends as transferred on signing and a new transfer term starts on the move date at the destination's quoted 12-month rent adjusted for the chosen term program, for at least the program's shortest new transfer term.

3.2 The transfer fee is assessed on signing, except that it is waived when the program waives it for an upsize and the destination floor plan ranks above the current one.

3.3 A transfer never triggers concession recapture, a reletting fee or an early termination fee; the security deposit carries over unchanged, and the move-out charges of the apartment home left behind are itemized under the Security Deposit Account rules at the final move-out.

3.4 Rent for the overlapping days is not charged twice: the old apartment home's rent stops the day before the move date.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A resident on the Extended Lease (13-15 Months) program with a fee of 500.00 dollars and an upsize waiver moves from a One-Bedroom Residence to a Two-Bedroom Residence (a higher-ranked floor plan): the fee is waived. Moving the other way, the fee of 500.00 dollars is assessed on signing. With a move date of 20 June, rent on the old apartment home stops on 19 June.
